escena: a young woman brand manager on the malecón of Puerto Baquerizo Moreno bends a long stiff cut-paper straight ruler into a graceful curve with both hands, a crate of glass soda bottles at her side; a sea lion naps at her feet and a frigatebird flies over the bay.

a worried young woman stands in a small meeting room with a harbor window, looking at a large cut-paper bar that is visibly shorter than the outline drawn on the wall above it; three committee members at a wooden table watch with raised eyebrows; a blue-footed booby looks in through the window.

a portable radio and an old television sit side by side on a harbor dock joined by a glowing cut-paper ribbon, and between them a pile of soda bottles grows taller and taller; a fisherman and a young woman look on delighted; a sea lion claps its flippers.

a slick salesman in a bright suit unrolls an extremely long tangled cut-paper squiggle across a pier in front of a skeptical young woman with her arms crossed; the squiggle loops wildly and knots on itself; a marine iguana sits on the end of it looking unimpressed.

a young woman on a white sand beach holds nine leashes at once, each attached to a playful sea lion pup pulling in a different direction; she gently reels all of them in together, every pup comes closer but none is let go.

a young woman with large tailor scissors snips several strings holding cut-paper balloons on a beach; most balloons float away over the sea, and only two remain tied in her hand; a Galápagos finch perches on the scissors.

five university students around a table in a bright room on San Cristóbal work on laptops with paper notes, one points at a curved cut-paper chart pinned on the wall, another checks a number with a pencil; the open door shows the harbor and a sleeping sea lion.

a young woman stands confidently at a table on the pier and hands a single short folded note to a committee member, behind her lies a huge discarded tangled pile of cut-paper curves; the sun rises over Kicker Rock in the background.
